title: Core banking migration schedule slip
description: Cutover plan for the core banking migration is three weeks behind because data mapping started late
mitigation: Add a data mapping squad and agree a revised cutover date with the steering committee

title: Loan system budget overrun
description: Vendor change requests are pushing the loan origination system cost above the approved budget
mitigation: Freeze non-critical change requests and review the budget with finance weekly

title: KYC refresh scope creep
description: Business teams keep adding new document types to the KYC refresh project after sign-off
mitigation: Enforce the change request process and defer new document types to phase two
review_notes: Raised in the last steering meeting

title: Key architect resignation
description: The lead solution architect has resigned and design knowledge is not fully documented
mitigation: Complete design handover documents and assign a backup architect

title: Payment vendor missed delivery
description: The payment vendor missed the agreed delivery date for the settlement module
mitigation: Escalate to the vendor account manager and apply the delay penalty clause

title: Regulatory reporting deadline at risk
description: Automated regulatory reports may not be ready before the regulator submission deadline
mitigation: Prepare a manual fallback report and agree priorities with the compliance team

title: Unstable test environment
description: The shared test environment is down for several hours each week and blocks testers
mitigation: Assign an environment owner and automate environment restarts

title: Open penetration test findings
description: High severity findings from the penetration test have not been fixed
mitigation: Fix the high severity findings and schedule a retest

title: Missing records after data migration
description: A trial data migration lost customer records because of mapping errors
mitigation: Run record count reconciliation and repeat the trial migration before cutover

title: Cloud costs above forecast
description: Cloud usage costs are running above the forecast used in the business case
mitigation: Set budget alerts and right-size the cloud resources

title: UAT users unavailable
description: Business users are not available for user acceptance testing during year end
mitigation: Agree a UAT calendar with business heads and book backup testers

title: Vulnerable third-party library
description: A third-party library used in the portal has a known security vulnerability
mitigation: Upgrade the library and add dependency scanning to the build

title: Unclear change approval path
description: Teams were unsure who approves change requests which delayed decisions
mitigation: Publish the approval matrix and share it with all teams
review_notes: Closed after approval matrix was published

title: Offshore time zone delays
description: Time zone gaps with the offshore team slow down defect fixes
mitigation: Agree overlap hours and hold a daily handover call

title: AML rules engine integration delay
description: Integration of the anti-money laundering rules engine is behind plan
mitigation: Add an integration specialist and test with sample alerts early

title: Audit findings not closed
description: Internal audit findings on access controls were not closed by the agreed date
mitigation: Prepare a corrective action plan and report weekly progress to the audit committee

title: Branch staff training incomplete
description: Training plan for branch staff on the new system is incomplete
mitigation: Finalise the training schedule and prepare short job aids

title: Vendor contract renewal unsigned
description: The support contract with a key vendor expires before the renewal is signed
mitigation: Get legal sign-off and agree a short extension if needed

title: Slow performance under load
description: The application response time is too slow during load testing
mitigation: Tune database queries and add caching for frequent requests

title: App store review delay
description: Mobile app release may be delayed by the app store review process
mitigation: Submit the app early and prepare answers for common review questions

title: Compliance requirements sign-off pending
description: Compliance sign-off on the requirements document was not received on time
mitigation: Hold a review session with compliance and record the decisions

title: Missing privacy impact assessment
description: A data privacy impact assessment has not been done for the new customer portal
mitigation: Complete the assessment with the data protection officer before launch

title: Single point of failure in payment design
description: The payment gateway design has no fallback if the primary service fails
mitigation: Add a secondary gateway and test failover

title: Contractor budget approval delayed
description: Budget approval for extra contractors is delayed and work has slowed
mitigation: Escalate to the programme lead for a decision this week

title: Disaster recovery test not scheduled
description: A disaster recovery test for the new platform has not been scheduled
mitigation: Book a test window and prepare the recovery runbook

title: Go-live date misalignment
description: Stakeholders have different expectations about the go-live date
mitigation: Hold an alignment workshop and publish one agreed release plan

title: Incomplete production access review
description: The access control review for production systems is incomplete
mitigation: Complete the review and remove unused accounts

title: Currency conversion defects
description: Several defects in the currency conversion module affect payment amounts
mitigation: Prioritise the fixes and add regression tests for conversion rules

title: Resource conflict with year-end release
description: Key developers are needed for both this project and the year-end release
mitigation: Agree resource allocation with the release manager and plan buffer time

title: Delayed handover to support team
description: Documentation handover to the support team is behind plan
mitigation: Set up handover sessions and assign a documentation owner
